decisions.reason: It remained on its own product page in 2023 and 2024, fits the firm’s established range, and in a growing industry with hiring and R&D this likely meets aspirations well enough to retain.
As an adjacent construction dumper that kept a dedicated page across both years, it appears satisfactory relative to aspiration levels and easy for this firm to support with existing capabilities.

This distant mine rescue vehicle lost prominence from a dedicated page to only a mention in 2024, suggesting weaker performance or strategic fit below aspiration and making it the most likely candidate for resource reallocation.
The telescopic loader stayed fully presented on its own page in both years and is close enough to the core business that organisational slack and existing service capabilities support keeping it.
The reported large order and statement that it is the most popular rental material lift indicate performance above aspiration, so there is little reason for problemistic search away from it.

Although more distant from the core range, the quantified early field use after seven months signals strong initial acceptance, which in a resource-capable innovative firm supports continuation rather than withdrawal.
